title: Subsequence criterion for an approximate tangent plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P, a ∈ ℝ^P and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim Q = n (Module.finrank ℝ Q = n). Write Hⁿ = μHE[n] and blowUpMap a λ y = λ⁻¹(y − a). Assume: for every sequence (λ_i)_{i∈ℕ} with λ_i > 0 for all i and λ_i → 0, there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that, for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{blowUpMap a λ_{φ(k)} '' M} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as k → ∞. Then M has approximate tangent space Q at a, i.e. HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M a Q: finrank Q = n and ∫_{blowUpMap a r '' M} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as r → 0⁺ (along 𝓝[>] 0) for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → (∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < lams i) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a (lams (φ k)) '' M, f y ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), f y ∂μHE[n]))) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M a Q
